original_test_intent: Verify every approved supported NIC speed negotiates and communicates correctly and that the physical speed/activity LED matches vendor specification through powered-off, powered-on idle and powered-on traffic states with defined WOL behavior.
original_method: Engineering signs a per-port speed/LED/state matrix; agent applies only approved non-management speed/IP settings and bounded ping, while operator captures LEDs and performs controlled WOL/power actions; each state is evidenced and final link/IP/WOL restored.
manual_activity: Engineer approves speed/state matrix; agent handles only signed OS link/IP/ping actions; qualified operator performs WOL/power and physical LED capture.
required_inputs: Supported speed/duplex/autoneg matrix and hardware-revision LED color/state specification
Isolated non-management port, IP plan, peer/client and bounded traffic
Authoritative WOL-disabled power-off/on sequence and expected wake behavior
Qualified operator/KVM, independent OOB, state rollback, abort/recovery and invalid-run policy
safety_requirements: Never force an unsupported mode or modify active management/BMC path
Require explicit approval and working independent recovery before link/IP/WOL/power changes
Track every original setting and deterministic rollback
Stop on access loss, failed negotiation/boot/WOL, route drift, network impact, errors or ambiguous LED
No automatic power-cycle, next-speed advance or retry after failure
agent_execution_scope: Enumerate capabilities and execute only approved OS speed/IP/ping profiles with complete status/counters
Coordinate timestamps with operator LED/power evidence and restore approved final state
Do not choose speeds, infer physical color, act on management path, operate power/WOL beyond approved scope or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Approve exact per-port speed/LED/power/WOL matrix and expected results
Review combined electronic/physical evidence and issue verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Incomplete: visual LED is manual, but supported link configuration and ping are automatable after approval; no unsafe generic command should be inferred.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: For each approved supported speed, use approved ethtool/ip configuration and bounded ping while operator captures LED in specified power/traffic state; restore original settings.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Supported10M/100M/1G/10G/100G subset, IP/connectivity, WOL-disabled power-off, power-on idle/traffic, ping and1/5 fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Execute a signed state matrix per port/speed with before, negotiated, idle, traffic, power/WOL and restored checkpoints.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds capability gating, target identity, safe rollback, time-aligned physical evidence and invalid-run boundaries.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Treating the case as only a visual LED check omits the source's negotiated-speed, IP, ping, WOL and power coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Many NICs do not support all listed speeds; forced speed may require autoneg changes, LED encodings vary by hardware, and WOL support depends on firmware/driver/power state.

project_override_considerations: Unsupported listed speeds are documented and excluded only by an approved capability matrix; the review does not force them or assume a generic LED color convention.
expected_evidence: Approval, operator and per-port NIC/driver/firmware/link-partner identities
Supported versus tested speed/duplex/autoneg matrix and vendor LED table
Original and per-speed link/IP/route/WOL settings plus rollback record
Per-speed negotiated status, ping, counters/errors and bounded traffic details
Power-off/WOL/power-on timestamps and physical LED media for idle/traffic states
Management/BMC continuity, logs/SEL, final restored state, invalid-run disposition and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The procedure's speed, connectivity, power/WOL and LED checks support the generic LED-spec criterion. Exact supported subset and state expectations are missing readiness decisions rather than contradictory source text.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The speed matrix, peer, operator, WOL/power and recovery plan can be supplied; static review is complete and later reviews can continue.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row52 Wistron-Networking-00035-V003: approve the exact NIC/physical-port/link-partner and supported10M/100M/1G/10G/100G subset, duplex/autoneg and vendor LED color/state matrix; define isolated non-management IP/peer/ping traffic, WOL-disabled power-off and power-on behavior, operator/KVM capture, independent OOB, per-speed timeout/abort, complete rollback of speed/IP/WOL, recovery and invalid-run policy. Unsupported modes must not be forced and ethtool must not substitute for physical LED evidence.

review_improvement: Restores every hybrid configuration, connectivity, power and visual phase while preventing unsupported speed forcing or management loss.
independent_technical_reasoning: LED validation is meaningful only when the negotiated speed and traffic/power state are independently proven. A configured speed can fail negotiation, and ethtool can report a link while the physical indicator is wrong; conversely a photo without electronic state cannot identify which mode it represents. Each state therefore needs synchronized electronic and physical evidence plus rollback.
